Thanks, Jana — got the attachments and certificate. A couple of clarifying items before we flip the supplier to active in Procure-to-Pay: 

1) PO/line mapping: we need a sample UBL element mapping for our PO lines. Specifically we map PO line->InvoiceLine
   - Redwood PO fields we hold: PO number, line_id, sku, description, quantity, unit_price, tax_code (VAT rate), cost_center
   - Can you confirm which UBL elements you populate for tax point and VAT percentage? Is it <% TaxSubtotal/TaxAmount %> and TaxCategory/Percent? (i.e., line-level breakdown present in your sample XML)

2) Buyer reference: please confirm you will populate the <cbc:ID> under OrderReference with our PO number when you send invoices. That is how our AP system auto-allocates.

3) Settlement terms & bank details: good to have IBAN/SWIFT included; can you confirm preferred remittance reference format (we prefer "Redwood PO {PO_NUMBER}")

4) PEPPOL / transmission: do you plan to send via PEPPOL BIS or via email with attachment? If PEPPOL, please confirm your participant ID.

If you can paste a short 3-line snippet showing how you represent VAT on a line in your sample_einvoice_ubl21.xml (you may paste the fragment inline) that will let our finance team validate mapping quickly.

Thanks — I looped in Laura from Ops.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the detailed checklist. Below is the XML fragment for a line-level VAT breakdown from our UBL 2.1 invoices (we include this per Slovak reporting rules):

<InvoiceLine>
  <ID>1</ID>
  <InvoicedQuantity unitCode="EA">10</InvoicedQuantity>
  <LineExtensionAmount currencyID="EUR">1000.00</LineExtensionAmount>
  <TaxTotal>
    <TaxAmount currencyID="EUR">200.00</TaxAmount>
    <TaxSubtotal>
      <TaxableAmount currencyID="EUR">1000.00</TaxableAmount>
      <TaxAmount currencyID="EUR">200.00</TaxAmount>
      <TaxCategory>
        <ID>S</ID>
        <Percent>20.00</Percent>
      </TaxCategory>
    </TaxSubtotal>
  </TaxTotal>
</InvoiceLine>

Notes:
- We populate <OrderReference><ID> with the buyer PO number when available.
- We can transmit via PEPPOL BIS 3.0 (participant ID: 0088:SLV-1894). If you prefer email with attachment we will also attach UBL.
- Remittance reference: we can set to "Redwood PO {PO_NUMBER}" as requested.

I'll also attach a cleaned sample file (sample_einvoice_ubl21.xml) showing a full invoice. Let me know if Finance needs a different VAT coding (our TaxCategory ID uses "S" for standard 20%).

Best regards,
Jana
